g.text: At the same ERA5 wind speed, power differs by 24% to 38% between the best and worst wind direction

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Observed power divided by the all-direction monotone curve, on half-hours whose fitted power is 40% to 90% of the top level, smoothed over about 18 degrees and divided by the all-direction average. Grey dashed line: no departure. Blue line: estimate. Blue band: 95% interval from re-drawing whole calendar months. The ratio mixes wake loss with any speed error in ERA5 that depends on direction.'
text.tspan: Observed power divided by the all-direction monotone curve, on half-hours whose fitted power is 40%
to 90% of the top level, smoothed over about 18 degrees and divided by the all-direction average.
Grey dashed line: no departure. Blue line: estimate. Blue band: 95% interval from re-drawing whole
calendar months. The ratio mixes wake loss with any speed error in ERA5 that depends on direction.
